WITH active_days AS (
    SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, CAST(e.event_ts AS DATE) AS d
    FROM labels l
    JOIN events e
      ON e.user_id = l.user_id
     AND e.ingested_at < l.label_ts
     AND e.event_ts >= l.label_ts - INTERVAL 14 DAY
    UNION
    SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, CAST(p.valid_from AS DATE) AS d
    FROM labels l
    JOIN plan_history p
      ON p.user_id = l.user_id
     AND p.ingested_at < l.label_ts
     AND p.valid_from >= l.label_ts - INTERVAL 14 DAY
)
SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned, COUNT(a.d) AS n_active_days
FROM labels l
LEFT JOIN active_days a ON a.user_id = l.user_id AND a.label_ts = l.label_ts
GROUP BY l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned

-- Events placed on the timeline at their load time; at a tie the spine row (kind 0) sorts
-- before the load (kind 1), and the frame stops one row before the spine row.
WITH timeline AS (
    SELECT user_id, ingested_at AS ts, 1 AS kind, amount,
           CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS label_ts, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS churned
    FROM staging.stg_events
    UNION ALL
    SELECT user_id, label_ts AS ts, 0 AS kind, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS amount, label_ts, churned
    FROM labels
),
scored AS (
    SELECT *,
           SUM(amount) OVER w AS spend_loaded_before,
           COUNT(amount) OVER w AS n_loaded_before
    FROM timeline
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, kind
                 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
)
SELECT user_id, label_ts, churned, spend_loaded_before, n_loaded_before
FROM scored
WHERE kind = 0

SELECT user_id, label_ts, churned,
       CASE WHEN LAG(label_ts) OVER w + INTERVAL 14 DAY < label_ts
            THEN LAG(churned) OVER w END AS prev_label_if_final
FROM labels
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY label_ts)

-- Events placed on the timeline at their load time; at a tie the spine row (kind 0) sorts
-- before the load (kind 1), and the frame stops one row before the spine row.
WITH timeline AS (
    SELECT user_id, ingested_at AS ts, 1 AS kind, amount,
           CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS label_ts, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS churned
    FROM staging.stg_events
    UNION ALL
    SELECT user_id, label_ts AS ts, 0 AS kind, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS amount, label_ts, churned
    FROM labels
),
scored AS (
    SELECT *,
           MAX(amount) OVER w AS spend_loaded_before,
           COUNT(amount) OVER w AS n_loaded_before
    FROM timeline
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, kind
                 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
)
SELECT user_id, label_ts, churned, spend_loaded_before, n_loaded_before
FROM scored
WHERE kind = 0

-- The frame stops 15 days before t: every label inside it is final at t.
WITH spine AS (
    SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned, en.country
    FROM labels l
    LEFT JOIN entities en ON en.user_id = l.user_id
)
SELECT user_id, label_ts, churned, country,
       AVG(churned)   OVER w AS country_churn_rate_final,
       COUNT(churned) OVER w AS n_final_labels
FROM spine
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY label_ts
             RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND INTERVAL 15 DAY PRECEDING)

WITH active_days AS (
    SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, CAST(e.event_ts AS DATE) AS d
    FROM labels l
    JOIN events e
      ON e.user_id = l.user_id
     AND e.ingested_at < l.label_ts
     AND e.event_ts >= l.label_ts - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    UNION
    SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, CAST(p.valid_from AS DATE) AS d
    FROM labels l
    JOIN plan_history p
      ON p.user_id = l.user_id
     AND p.ingested_at < l.label_ts
     AND p.valid_from >= l.label_ts - INTERVAL 30 DAY
)
SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned, COUNT(a.d) AS n_active_days
FROM labels l
LEFT JOIN active_days a ON a.user_id = l.user_id AND a.label_ts = l.label_ts
GROUP BY l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned

WITH loaded_spend AS (
    SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned,
           COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) AS spend_loaded,
           COUNT(e.event_id)          AS orders_loaded
    FROM labels l
    LEFT JOIN events e
           ON e.user_id = l.user_id
          AND e.ingested_at < l.label_ts
    GROUP BY l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned
)
SELECT ls.user_id, ls.label_ts, ls.churned,
       ls.spend_loaded,
       ls.spend_loaded - s.total_spend AS spend_since_recompute,
       ls.orders_loaded - s.n_orders   AS orders_since_recompute
FROM loaded_spend ls
ASOF LEFT JOIN user_stats s
  ON s.user_id = ls.user_id
 AND ls.label_ts > s.updated_at

-- Events placed on the timeline at their load time; at a tie the spine row (kind 0) sorts
-- before the load (kind 1), and the frame stops one row before the spine row.
WITH timeline AS (
    SELECT user_id, ingested_at AS ts, 1 AS kind, amount,
           CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS label_ts, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS churned
    FROM staging.stg_events
    UNION ALL
    SELECT user_id, label_ts AS ts, 0 AS kind, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS amount, label_ts, churned
    FROM labels
),
scored AS (
    SELECT *,
           AVG(amount) OVER w AS spend_loaded_before,
           COUNT(amount) OVER w AS n_loaded_before
    FROM timeline
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, kind
                 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
)
SELECT user_id, label_ts, churned, spend_loaded_before, n_loaded_before
FROM scored
WHERE kind = 0

-- Lapsed buyer: a known purchase in the earlier window but none in the recent window.
WITH known AS (
    SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, e.event_ts
    FROM labels l
    JOIN staging.stg_events e
      ON e.user_id = l.user_id
     AND e.ingested_at < l.label_ts
     AND e.event_ts >= l.label_ts - INTERVAL 60 DAY
),
earlier AS (
    SELECT user_id, label_ts FROM known WHERE event_ts <  label_ts - INTERVAL 30 DAY
),
recent AS (
    SELECT user_id, label_ts FROM known WHERE event_ts >= label_ts - INTERVAL 30 DAY
),
lapsed AS (
    SELECT user_id, label_ts FROM earlier
    EXCEPT
    SELECT user_id, label_ts FROM recent
)
SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned, lp.user_id IS NOT NULL AS is_lapsed
FROM labels l
LEFT JOIN lapsed lp ON lp.user_id = l.user_id AND lp.label_ts = l.label_ts

-- valid_to is safe here: a version that ended more than 8 days before t was closed by a load
-- that happened before t.
SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned,
       COUNT(p.user_id)                                  AS n_completed_plans,
       AVG(date_diff('day', p.valid_from, p.valid_to))   AS avg_completed_plan_days
FROM labels l
LEFT JOIN plan_history p
       ON p.user_id = l.user_id
      AND p.valid_to < l.label_ts - INTERVAL 10 DAY
GROUP BY ALL

-- valid_to is safe here: a version that ended more than 8 days before t was closed by a load
-- that happened before t.
SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned,
       COUNT(p.user_id)                                  AS n_completed_plans,
       AVG(date_diff('day', p.valid_from, p.valid_to))   AS avg_completed_plan_days
FROM labels l
LEFT JOIN plan_history p
       ON p.user_id = l.user_id
      AND p.valid_to < l.label_ts - INTERVAL 8 DAY
GROUP BY ALL

SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned,
       regr_slope(s.total_spend, epoch(s.updated_at) / 86400.0) AS spend_per_day_trend,
       regr_slope(s.n_orders,    epoch(s.updated_at) / 86400.0) AS orders_per_day_trend
FROM labels l
LEFT JOIN analytics.staging.stg_user_stats s
       ON s.user_id = l.user_id
      AND s.updated_at < l.label_ts
      AND s.updated_at >= l.label_ts - INTERVAL 28 DAY
GROUP BY l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned

SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned,
       regr_slope(s.total_spend, epoch(s.updated_at) / 86400.0) AS spend_per_day_trend,
       regr_slope(s.n_orders,    epoch(s.updated_at) / 86400.0) AS orders_per_day_trend
FROM labels l
LEFT JOIN analytics.staging.stg_user_stats s
       ON s.user_id = l.user_id
      AND s.updated_at < l.label_ts
      AND s.updated_at >= l.label_ts - INTERVAL 14 DAY
GROUP BY l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned

WITH timeline AS (
    SELECT user_id, updated_at AS ts, 1 AS kind, updated_at AS stats_ts,
           CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS label_ts, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS churned
    FROM staging.stg_user_stats
    UNION ALL BY NAME
    SELECT user_id, label_ts AS ts, 0 AS kind, label_ts, churned
    FROM marts.fct_training_spine
),
filled AS (
    SELECT *,
           MAX(stats_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, kind
                               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS last_stats_ts
    FROM timeline
)
SELECT f.user_id, f.label_ts, f.churned,
       date_diff('hour', f.last_stats_ts, f.label_ts) AS stats_age_hours,
       s.n_orders                                     AS n_orders_known
FROM filled f
LEFT JOIN staging.stg_user_stats s
       ON s.user_id = f.user_id
      AND s.updated_at = f.last_stats_ts
WHERE f.kind = 0

-- t read as UTC and shown in a zone west of UTC: the bound moves earlier, never later.
SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned,
       COUNT(e.event_id) AS n_orders_14d,
       SUM(e.amount)     AS spend_14d
FROM labels l
LEFT JOIN events e
       ON e.user_id = l.user_id
      AND e.ingested_at < timezone('America/New_York', timezone('UTC', l.label_ts))
      AND e.event_ts >= l.label_ts - INTERVAL 14 DAY
GROUP BY ALL

-- t read as UTC and shown in a zone west of UTC: the bound moves earlier, never later.
SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned,
       COUNT(e.event_id) AS n_orders_14d,
       SUM(e.amount)     AS spend_14d
FROM labels l
LEFT JOIN events e
       ON e.user_id = l.user_id
      AND e.ingested_at < timezone('America/Los_Angeles', timezone('UTC', l.label_ts))
      AND e.event_ts >= l.label_ts - INTERVAL 14 DAY
GROUP BY ALL

-- Lapsed buyer: a known purchase in the earlier window but none in the recent window.
WITH known AS (
    SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, e.event_ts
    FROM labels l
    JOIN staging.stg_events e
      ON e.user_id = l.user_id
     AND e.ingested_at < l.label_ts
     AND e.event_ts >= l.label_ts - INTERVAL 60 DAY
),
earlier AS (
    SELECT user_id, label_ts FROM known WHERE event_ts <  label_ts - INTERVAL 21 DAY
),
recent AS (
    SELECT user_id, label_ts FROM known WHERE event_ts >= label_ts - INTERVAL 21 DAY
),
lapsed AS (
    SELECT user_id, label_ts FROM earlier
    EXCEPT
    SELECT user_id, label_ts FROM recent

SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned, lp.user_id IS NOT NULL AS is_lapsed
FROM labels l
LEFT JOIN lapsed lp ON lp.user_id = l.user_id AND lp.label_ts = l.label_ts
